title: AS2: Getter/setter property compilation
description: Ensure AS2 getter/setter (addProperty or get/set syntax) compiles correctly. Flash 8 AS2 getters/setters use Object.addProperty(obj, name, getter, setter). If the class-level get/set syntax is not in the compiler, add it. Tests: a class with a getter returns correct bytecode (ActionCallFunction to addProperty), setter works similarly.
